Drop the Navisworks-2024 build of CamelGraph into this folder:

  CamelGraph.App.dll        (the plugin entry — must sit directly in .\2024\)
  CamelGraph.Core.dll
  CamelGraph.Nodes.dll
  CamelGraph.Navisworks.dll
  CamelGraph.UI.dll
  Nodify.dll
  Newtonsoft.Json.dll
  AutomaticGraphLayout.dll   (Arrange; optional - without it Arrange uses simple columns)

A Debug build does this automatically (see the DeployToBundle target in
src/CamelGraph.App/CamelGraph.App.csproj — it deploys straight into
%APPDATA%\Autodesk\ApplicationPlugins\CamelGraph.bundle). For a manual install,
build the solution on Windows and copy the files above from
src/CamelGraph.App/bin/<Configuration>/net48/ into this folder, then copy the
whole CamelGraph.bundle folder to:

  %APPDATA%\Autodesk\ApplicationPlugins\        (per user)
  or
  C:\ProgramData\Autodesk\ApplicationPlugins\   (all users)

The en-US\CamelGraph.xaml ribbon layout and Resources\ icons beside this file
are already in place — Navisworks shows CamelGraph on the "BIMCamel" ribbon tab.
